description: Needs an Alion account or an x402 payment (not free on this open address). Public procurement from the tender graph (TED, USAspending and national portals, millions of notices and awards): pass company= for the contracts a company won (its own share of each, newest first), buyer= for the tenders a public body put out, ending_within= for contracts whose term ends soon (who is about to re-tender and whose client may go), or country= for a country's notices. Narrow with status (open, awarded...), since, min_value_usd, category (a CPV or UNSPSC prefix) and query (words in the title). Each row: title, buyer, country, status, kind, method, category, value, dates (published, deadline, awarded, contract start and end), bidders, the supplier(s) with their award, and the notice link. A framework's value is its ceiling across all suppliers; a supplier's share is the award's. count_only is free. $0.01 a contract. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

buyer.description: A public buyer: its domain, id or name - the tenders it put out.

category.description: A CPV or UNSPSC code prefix, e.g. "72" (IT services) or "722".

company.description: A supplier: its domain, id or name - the contracts it won.

country.description: ISO code of the country of the notice.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; keep the other arguments identical.

ending_within.description: Contracts whose term ends within this window: "90d", "6m", "1y".

min_value_usd.description: At least this value in USD (the award's with company=).

query.description: Words that must appear in the title.

since.description: Published after this point: an ISO date or a window ("90d").

status.description: The notice status; "open" also needs the deadline ahead.

name: search_contracts

value_usd.description: The notice value; the ceiling of a framework

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

mark.description: People tools: the code of this account and UTC day; every list of people read today carries it

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor, other arguments unchanged.

warnings.description: Arguments that were ignored or matched nothing, with what to try instead.

title: Public contracts and tenders
